review: 702.26p-1: one_instance was labelled fires although it is the identical-outcome control for a redundancy rule; relabelled it other and noted in forge_notes that 702.26p genuinely has no does_not_fire branch.

skipped.reason: an object that would phase out both directly and indirectly phases in at the same untap step as its host either way, so no outcome in a two-player game distinguishes the two; 702.26g-1 covers the indirect case

scenarios.title: Phasing happens in the controller's untap step: phased-in permanents with phasing phase out and phased-out ones phase in

setup.notes: Sandbar Crocodile (6/5, phasing) is phased in. B's end step; the next turn is A's.

decisions: Both players pass in B's end step; the turn passes to A.
A's untap step begins: A's phasing permanents phase out and A's phased-out permanents phase in simultaneously, before untapping. No player receives priority during the untap step.

variants.label: phases_out
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile phases out. It stays on the battlefield (no zone change) but is treated as not existing; A controls no creatures this turn.

variants.label: phases_in
variants.delta: Sandbar Crocodile starts phased out (it phased out under A's control in A's previous untap step).
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile phases in and is treated as existing again: A controls a 6/5 creature and it does not phase out again this untap step.

variants.label: opponents_untap_step
variants.delta: Sandbar Crocodile is controlled by B instead of A (phased in).
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile stays phased in during A's untap step; only its controller's untap step makes it phase.

variants.label: no_phasing
variants.delta: The permanent is Grizzly Bears (no phasing) instead of Sandbar Crocodile.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays phased in; nothing phases.

scenarios.title: A phased-out permanent is not destroyed by a sweeper

setup.notes: Sandbar Crocodile phased out during this turn's untap step (it is phased out now).

decisions: A casts Wrath of God, tapping four Plains.
Both players pass; Wrath of God resolves.

variants.label: phased_out
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is destroyed and moves to B's graveyard. The phased-out Sandbar Crocodile is not affected: it stays on the battlefield.

variants.label: phased_in
variants.delta: Sandbar Crocodile is phased in (it phased in during this turn's untap step).
variants.expected: Both Grizzly Bears and Sandbar Crocodile are destroyed and move to their owners' graveyards.

scenarios.title: A permanent that phases out is removed from combat

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is attacking B. Hill Giant has been declared as its blocker. Priority is with A in the declare blockers step.

decisions: A casts Reality Ripple targeting Hill Giant, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Reality Ripple resolves.
Combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: blocker_phases_out
variants.expected: Hill Giant phases out and is removed from combat. Grizzly Bears stays blocked and deals no damage to B (B's life 20); Grizzly Bears takes no damage and survives.

variants.label: no_phasing
variants.delta: A does not cast Reality Ripple.
variants.expected: Hill Giant deals 3 damage to Grizzly Bears, which dies; Hill Giant takes 2 damage and survives. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: attacker_phases_out
variants.delta: Reality Ripple targets A's own Grizzly Bears instead of Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears phases out and is removed from combat. No combat damage is dealt: Hill Giant survives undamaged, B's life stays 20.

scenarios.title: Phasing is not a zone change: no enter or leave triggers and counters stay

setup.notes: Elvish Visionary has an enters-the-battlefield draw trigger and a +1/+1 counter. Observation point is the end of A's next untap step.

decisions: A casts Reality Ripple targeting Elvish Visionary, tapping Island and Island.
Both players pass; Reality Ripple resolves.
The turn passes; B does nothing. At A's next untap step Elvish Visionary phases in.

variants.label: phasing
variants.expected: Elvish Visionary phases out then back in without changing zones: no enters-the-battlefield trigger and no card is drawn, and it keeps its +1/+1 counter (2/2).

variants.label: blink
variants.delta: A casts Cloudshift (tapping Plains) targeting Elvish Visionary instead of Reality Ripple.
variants.expected: Elvish Visionary is exiled and returns as a new object, its enters-the-battlefield trigger fires and A draws a card; the +1/+1 counter is gone (1/1).

scenarios.title: A continuous effect from a resolved spell does not include a permanent that is phased out

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears (B's) is phased out and phases in during B's next untap step. Mass Diminish's effect lasts until A's next turn. Observation point is B's main phase 1 after that untap step.

decisions: A casts Mass Diminish targeting player B, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Mass Diminish resolves.
The turn passes to B; B's untap step phases Grizzly Bears in.

variants.label: phased_out_when_resolved
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears is not included in the effect: after phasing in it is a 2/2.

variants.label: phased_in_when_resolved
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is phased in when Mass Diminish resolves.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has base power and toughness 1/1 until A's next turn, including in B's main phase 1.

scenarios.forge_notes: Setting up a phased-out Grizzly Bears needs either a previous Reality Ripple or a puzzle-state flag.

scenarios.title: A for-as-long-as control effect ends when the permanent it tracks phases out

setup.notes: A controls B's Hill Giant through Sower of Temptation's enters-the-battlefield effect (for as long as Sower of Temptation remains on the battlefield). Hill Giant is owned by B.

decisions: A passes priority in main phase 1.
B casts Reality Ripple targeting Sower of Temptation, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Reality Ripple resolves.

variants.label: sower_phases_out
variants.expected: Sower of Temptation phases out and the control effect ends: Hill Giant returns to B's control.

variants.label: no_phasing
variants.delta: B does not cast Reality Ripple.
variants.expected: Sower of Temptation stays phased in and A keeps control of Hill Giant.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge ends Sower's effect via LoseControl$ LeavesPlay; phasing out may not be handled the same way.

scenarios.title: Equipment phases out and in along with the permanent it is attached to

setup.notes: Bonesplitter is attached to Sandbar Crocodile (phasing). B's end step; the next turn is A's.

decisions: Both players pass in B's end step; the turn passes to A.
A's untap step begins and phasing is applied.

variants.label: attached_equipment
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile phases out and Bonesplitter phases out with it (indirectly); both are treated as not existing.

variants.label: unattached_equipment
variants.delta: Bonesplitter is not attached to Sandbar Crocodile.
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile phases out; Bonesplitter stays phased in.

variants.label: phasing_in
variants.delta: Sandbar Crocodile and Bonesplitter start phased out (Bonesplitter phased out indirectly with it).
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile phases in and Bonesplitter phases in with it, still attached; Sandbar Crocodile is 8/5.

scenarios.title: A directly phased-out Equipment phases in attached to its host if the host is still there

setup.notes: Bonesplitter is phased out (directly, by an earlier Reality Ripple) and was attached to Grizzly Bears when it phased out. B's end step; the next turn is A's.

decisions: Both players pass in B's end step; the turn passes to A.
A's untap step begins: Bonesplitter phases in.

variants.label: host_still_there
variants.expected: Bonesplitter phases in attached to Grizzly Bears, which is 4/2.

variants.label: host_gone
variants.delta: Grizzly Bears is in A's graveyard instead of on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Bonesplitter phases in unattached and stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Phasing out with an attachment causes no unattach trigger

setup.notes: Grafted Wargear: whenever it becomes unattached from a permanent, sacrifice that permanent.

decisions: A casts Reality Ripple targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping both Islands.
Both players pass; Reality Ripple resolves.

variants.label: phasing
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears phases out and Grafted Wargear phases out with it. Grafted Wargear's unattach trigger does not fire and nothing is sacrificed.

variants.label: equip_moves
variants.delta: Instead of casting Reality Ripple, A activates Equip {0} targeting Hill Giant.
variants.expected: Grafted Wargear becomes unattached from Grizzly Bears, its trigger fires, and Grizzly Bears is sacrificed (moves to A's graveyard). Hill Giant is 6/5.

scenarios.title: If the untap step is skipped, no phasing occurs

setup.notes: Stasis (players skip their untap steps) is on B's battlefield. B's end step; the next turn is A's.

decisions: Both players pass in B's end step; the turn passes to A.
A's untap step is skipped.

variants.label: untap_skipped
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile does not phase out and stays phased in.

variants.label: no_stasis
variants.delta: Stasis is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: A's untap step happens and Sandbar Crocodile phases out.

variants.label: phased_out_start
variants.expected: Sandbar Crocodile does not phase in and stays phased out.

scenarios.title: Multiple instances of phasing on one permanent are redundant

setup.notes: Sandbar Crocodile has phasing printed and a second instance from Teferi's Curse. Observation points are after A's untap step this turn and after A's next untap step.

decisions: Both players pass in B's end step; the turn passes to A.
A's untap step: phasing is applied. The turn cycle repeats until A's next untap step.

variants.label: two_instances
variants.expected: After the first untap step Sandbar Crocodile (and Teferi's Curse, indirectly) is phased out once; after the next untap step it is phased in once.

variants.label: one_instance
variants.delta: Teferi's Curse is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Same result as with two instances: Sandbar Crocodile is phased out after the first untap step and phased in after the next.

scenarios.forge_notes: Teferi's Curse phases out indirectly with the host, so the attached aura is part of the observed state. A redundancy rule has no does_not_fire branch: no board state lets a second instance change the outcome, so the one-instance variant is the identical-outcome control.
